dialogdialogue.text: Whoa, B. Kyu. Did your glam squad quit on you? You look... busted.
PJ... that's Love. My creator. But her energy... it's all wrong. It's... hungry.
BUSTED?! HAHAHA! This isn't busted, sweetie. This is what PERFECTION looks like when it finally stops pretending!
I am ALWAYS hotter than you!
Hotter...? Love, you feel... so cold. What happened to you?
SILENCE! Don't you DARE! You're nothing but a pathetic little memory I coughed up when I was feeling sentimental! A MISTAKE!
Yo, back the fuck off! You don't get to talk to my girlfriend like that!
Girlfriend? How cute. You think your little D-list romance can compete with the adoration of MILLIONS?
I'll show you what real star power looks like!
